claims: UFC 327 takes place on Saturday, April 11, 2026.
UFC 327 takes place at the Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida.
UFC 327 is headlined by a light heavyweight title fight between Jiří Procházka and Carlos Ulberg.
The main card of UFC 327 begins at 9:00 p.m. ET.
The early prelims of UFC 327 start at 5:30 p.m. ET.
The prelims of UFC 327 start at 7:00 p.m. ET.
